subject: Runbook & Access: dual-track API onramp coordination
body:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sloan Roberts <sloan@quoinpay.com>, Elena Martins <elena@quoinpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runbook & Access: dual-track API onramp coordination

Hi Sloan / Elena —

Thanks again for the quick intro call today. To make the initial enablement as low-friction as possible, we propose a dual-track onramp: one focused on API integration (endpoints, auth, SDKs, and sample calls) and a parallel compact console walkthrough (keys, routing, and observability). Goal: get your two engineers unblocked with both sides in 90 minutes total (2 × 45 min parallel tracks) or—if you prefer—two consecutive 60-minute sessions with overlap for Q&A.

Can you confirm:
- Who will join from QuoinPay (names & roles)?
- Your preferred timezone window over the next 48 hours (we suggested PDT mornings below).
- Any network/security blockers (VPN, IP allowlist) we should pre-stage.

I attached a short preflight checklist (RF-onramp-preflight.pdf) — please skim items 1–4 (API keys, test account, admin consent) before the session. I’ll send a calendar invite after you confirm the slot.

Proposed slots (Pacific / converted internally to your local time):
- Option A: Wed 2025-06-11 09:00–10:30 PDT — two parallel 45-min tracks then 15-min cross-track Q&A
- Option B: Wed 2025-06-11 11:00–12:30 PDT — two consecutive 60-min sessions (API first)

If neither works, we can do Thu morning as a fallback.

Thanks — I’ll hold both tentative slots for now.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
E: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Sloan Roberts <sloan@quoinpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Martins <elena@quoinpay.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runbook & Access: dual-track API onramp coordination

Tessa —

Thanks, this looks good. Quick notes from our side:
- Attendees: Me (Head of Eng), Priya Desai (Backend), Marco Lu (SRE) — only two folks can be deep in the session at once, so the split tracks make sense.
- Preference: Option B (consecutive 60-min sessions) would be easier for our schedule, with API first then console.
- Security ask: please send a SOC2 evidence checklist and an IP allowlist stub we can forward to procurement. Also confirm whether test keys in the sandbox expire after 7 days (we may need a longer TTL).

Can you run the API session at 11:00 PDT and console at 12:00 PDT? We’ll have Marco drop off after the console if necessary.

—Sloan
Sloan Roberts
Head of Engineering | QuoinPay
sloan@quoinpay.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Runbook & Access: dual-track API onramp coordination

Team — forwarding Sloan's reply. QuoinPay wants consecutive 60-min sessions on Wed 6/11: 11:00 PDT API, 12:00 PDT console. Attendees: Sloan, Priya (Backend), Marco (SRE). Please confirm who can lead which track and whether we can offer test keys with a 14-day TTL for this trial.

Proposed assignments (feel free to swap):
- Ben: API deep-dive (auth, SDK examples, quick curl checks) — lead trainer
- Camila: Console walkthrough (keys, routing, per-route tracing, observability) — lead co-trainer
- Grace: infra/key-ops and allowlist/SOC2 onboarding notes — backup and procurement point

Ben — do you have an updated runbook snippet for the 14-day key TTL flow? Camila — can you prepare a 10-slide console deck and the short demo account with 'finpay-demo' org ready? Grace — can you pull the SOC2 checklist we keep under Drive link below?

Thanks — need confirmations by EOD so I can send the invites.

—Tessa

Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Tessa —
> 
> I can lead the API session. I have a lighter deck that focuses on integration pitfalls and a 10-min live curl-based token exchange demo. I’ll also prepare the 14-day test-key flow; note it requires an extra step in our provisioning script but is fine for a short trial.
> 
> Ben
> Senior Enablement Engineer | Redwood Inference

Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> I’ll take the console walkthrough. Will prepare a short runbook and demo org (finpay-demo). I can also record a 10-min clip in case they want to share with stakeholders.
> 
> Camila
> Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference

Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> I’ve pulled the SOC2 checklist (link below) and will add a short allowlist template. I can be on the call for procurement questions.
> 
> Grace
> Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sloan Roberts <sloan@quoinpay.com>, Elena Martins <elena@quoinpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runbook & Access: dual-track API onramp coordination — confirmed

Sloan / Elena —

Thanks for confirming. We’re set for the consecutive sessions on Wed, 2025-06-11:
- API session: 11:00–12:00 PDT (Ben Carter leading)
- Console session: 12:00–13:00 PDT (Camila Reyes leading)

Attachments: RF-onramp-preflight.pdf (preflight checklist), dual-track-invite.ics (calendar invite).

Prep notes / prerequisites (please action before the API session):
1) Whitelist: please add our sandbox IP block 34.210.128.0/24 to your allowlist (Grace attached a template).
2) Test account: confirm the two tester emails (Priya and Marco) so we can provision finpay-demo access.
3) Keys: test keys will be issued with 14-day TTL for this trial; Ben will trigger provisioning once test emails are confirmed.
4) Procurement: you asked for SOC2 evidence — Grace will email the checklist and stub; if procurement needs an NDA or longer key TTL we can escalate.

Quick links: implementation runbook (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onramp-runbook) and HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4392).

If the attendees prefer recorded material, we’ll share the 10-min console clip after the session.

I’ll send the confirmed calendar invites (attached) and the provisioning note once you reply with Priya and Marco’s emails.

See you tomorrow —
Tessa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
